name: Old Port
description: The old harbour at the heart of the city, lined with cafés and moored boats, with a small fish market on the quay most mornings.

name: Château d’If
description: A 16th-century fortress and former prison on an island in the bay, the setting of The Count of Monte Cristo. Boats leave from the Old Port.

name: Cité Radieuse
description: Le Corbusier’s 1952 concrete housing block on stilts, with shops and a hotel on an inside street and a terrace on the roof.
